content: As expected this host is fighting me: QED 0.590, SA 3.48, LogP 5.25 at 415 Da. The dimethylmorpholine arm is the one thing I can cheaply remove - atom 18 is the methylene joining the thiazole nitrogen to the morpholine nitrogen at atom 19, a non-ring bond, so cutting it discards all seven morpholine atoms and leaves a simple N-methyl on the core. That takes about 115 Da off and should bring SA and LogP back toward sane values. I will stop there rather than also bolting on an anilide: adding another 110 Da to a molecule already at QED 0.59 would make it uninterpretable, whereas a compact single-link version still answers the question I care about - whether this link works on an aryl ring that is part of a fused heterocycle, or only on a plain benzene.
